correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the finite directed multipath definition on the 24 arcs of K_{2,2,2}: indegree/outdegree <=1 and no directed cycles, hence at most five arcs. Independently enumerated all 1,816 nonempty faces by brute arc subsets, obtaining (24,192,616,744,240), reproduced 835 acyclic Morse pairs and critical dimensions (one vertex, 12 two-cells, 101 three-cells, 32 four-cells). Independently computed mod-two boundary ranks (23,169,444,208), then exact signed Morse cancellation, giving the only differential 12x101 with 257 nonzero entries and integer Smith factors nine 1s and zeros; therefore reduced integral homology is Z^3 in degree2, Z^92 in degree3, Z^32 in degree4 with no torsion. This establishes homology, not a homotopy wedge. The general top-degree 32 is acknowledged prior rather than new.
residual_risks: Verification was bounded to the explicitly described finite checks and inspected proof; no broader generalization beyond stated domain.
